name: After recital L
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: Lc. whereas in Ukraine history textbooks such as ‘Zakhyst Ukrayiny’ issued in 2023 and used in 10th grade in Ukrainian schools present falsified narrative that relativises the Volhynian genocide and the crimes of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA); whereas such textbooks present Stepan Bandera, Roman Shukhevych and the UPA as heroes of the Ukrainian independence movement without mentioning their full role in crimes committed by UPA forces in Volhynia and Eastern Galicia against Poles, Jews, Czechs, Russians, Armenians, other minorities and Ukrainians who opposed their actions; whereas the textbook presents a narrative in which UPA members never acted against the civilian population and all acts of terror against civilians were committed by soviet agents in disguise;
